items.title: Access from anywhere, bought on your computer
items.text: Subscribe in API Access for $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year: pay in your browser, and access from anywhere turns on a few seconds later, no phone needed. Manage billing changes the card or cancels.

items.title: Choose what each person may use
items.text: Turn files, pictures, voice, the web, Knowledge, automations, and more on or off for each role and each person, and the app hides what's off for them. Admins can also manage people from a script or server.

items.title: Report a problem from where it happens
items.text: Report this sits beside errors in chat, on pages, and in automations. It shows everything it sends, lets you add what you were doing, and reaches the Toskar team as an issue, grouped with others who hit the same thing.

items.title: Long chats, summarized your way
items.text: Auto-compact shows the summary that stands in for older messages, so you can read and correct it, compact now, start a new chat from it, or keep a chat word for word.

items.title: Photos and files in chats on your phone
items.text: Ask about a photo, PDF, or text file in a chat on the device itself. It's read right there, scanned pages too, and a model that can't see photos gets the text in them.

items.title: Typos welcome
items.text: "whats teh wether tomorow" looks up the weather, "evry mornign at 8" runs every morning at 8, and "mistrl" finds Mistral in Models. Real words are left alone.
